body:
I made some comments in a first look through but I will wait until things are cleaned up to go further.

Some general comments:

Init files need to be updated so that whatever needs to come out in the API reference documentation does so accordingly.

In terms of the xyz file coming out in the current directory, I am not sure if this is a default when the user is explicitly saving such as file - I assume there is value in the user having one of these. Or if its some byproduct during say plotting where I think it ought to be created by default in the users temp folder and arguably deleted once it has been consumed/used.

Perhaps the docs, via one of these classes or init file, should show a small example of an xyz file and some description should a user not have come across this before

I did an initial review of this. Besides my comments below please remove the following files:
- `tmpatytns2w`
- `test/results/.pylintdict`
Mostly comments around docs. I need to look at the resultant html to see what is/is not there etc. But I'll complete this review and if I see anything else do another.
Some initial comments. I still need to do another pass of the larger files and look at the changes to tutorial notebook. Will do those things tomorrow :+1:

Besides this there are still a few comments open on the tutorial notebook. They may be hidden by Github due to the larger number of comments in my previous PR.

I also noticed that now there is a **lot** of Javascript being added to the notebook. Presumably because of the `%matplotlib notebook` lines. What benefit do these bring? Are they really necessary?
Besides these minor comments there are also still some unresolved conversations left over. Please go through the discussion tab of this PR and make sure you address/resolve all open comments :+1:

So, apparently I had to review the changes in order for my comments to be posted. You might see a lot of comments all of the sudden. Don't be concerned about them and just look at the last ones.
Other than that this seems pretty much good to go, once the CI is fixed :+1:
Thanks for the work doing this. All looks good to me. I made a very minor last minute change to the reno (an `and` to a `but`).
